snippet.title: White Dwarf: A cosmic survival roguelite. | Teaser
snippet.description:
A cosmic survival roguelite. You are a dying star, and the rock field around you never stops closing in. Survive relentless waves, draft upgrades between levels, and save your cooldowns for when the gaps disappear. Every boss you defeat returns as a regular enemy for the rest of the run.


Early Access on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5020280/White_Dwarf/

#roguelite #indiegame
